Name: Program Counter Update for Branches
objective: Compute the two candidate next PCs and show how BEQ selects the actual fetch address.
learning_objective: Compute the two candidate next PCs and show how BEQ selects the actual fetch address.
core_conclusion: BEQ chooses branch-PC plus offset when equal; otherwise execution continues at PC plus four in RV32I.

terminology.scope: RV32I 32-bit instructions, no compressed extension; branch offsets shown in bytes. The architectural decision is independent of any particular pipeline.

references.basis: Conditional Branches specifies comparison and target relative to the branch instruction; RV32I sequential instructions are four bytes.

sources.scope: Conditional Branches specifies comparison and target relative to the branch instruction; RV32I sequential instructions are four bytes.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: PC points at branch; both candidate slots empty.
scenes.trigger: Decode the branch displacement and form both additions.
scenes.change: Copy PC 0x100 into two arithmetic lanes; add 4 and 16; populate candidate address cells.
scenes.cause: Decode the branch displacement and form both additions.
scenes.result: Two distinct candidates 0x104 and 0x110 are visible before selection.
english_copy: One branch, two possible next addresses.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Both register values are 7; PC is still 0x100.
scenes.change: Carry the two 7 tokens into the comparator; equality selects the target address; move 0x110 into next-PC input while 0x104 remains unselected.
scenes.result: Next-PC input is 0x110 and the architectural PC stays 0x100 until update.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.trigger: The next fetch updates the PC.
scenes.change: Replace PC with 0x110 and move the instruction-memory cursor past 0x104 and 0x108 onto 0x110.
scenes.cause: The next fetch updates the PC.
scenes.result: The actual fetched address becomes 0x110; skipped rows never become the current PC.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Replay the same branch with x2=9; PC explicitly resets to 0x100.
scenes.change: Select the 0x104 candidate; carry it into PC; move the cursor exactly one 32-bit instruction forward.
scenes.result: PC and fetch cursor both end at 0x104, while target 0x110 stays unselected.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.trigger: Compare their final architectural PC values.
scenes.change: Place the two actual resulting fetch positions side by side, with equality operands next to each.
scenes.cause: Compare their final architectural PC values.
scenes.result: Changing the comparison changes which computed address is installed.
english_copy: The target is not PC + 4 + offset.

critical_processes.uncertainty: The selected candidate must become the PC, without adding offset to PC+4.

critical_processes.uncertainty: False BEQ must select sequential path.

title: Program Counter Update for Branches: Choose the Next Fetch
prompt:
A 30-second silent English educational animation for a university digital electronics course on Program Counter Update for Branches: compute fall-through 0x104 and target 0x110 from branch PC 0x100 with displacement 16; compare 7 with 7, install 0x110 in the PC at 15 seconds, and relocate the fetch selection past 0x104 and 0x108; replay the same branch with 7 and 9 so PC and fetch select 0x104 at 23 seconds, then compare the taken and not-taken destinations.

Use a radial dark background from #142238 through #0d1626 to #070b12 with a 72px grid and a #60a5fa glow; primary #60a5fa marks main fields, registers, or paths, accent #fbbf24 marks carried values and selected quantities, result #34d399 marks completed values or valid selections, and warn #f87171 marks discarded or unavailable work; use Helvetica Neue with Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI, and sans-serif fallbacks, 50px headings at weight 700, 30px body copy, and 21px uppercase kickers with 5px tracking; at 30 fps, slide-up headings 22px over 16 frames from frame 8 and stagger-in copy from frame 20 in 11-frame steps with 12-frame fades and 16px rises; marker-travel splits PC candidates over 65 frames and moves the fetch selection at frames 450 and 690; keep selected next-PC and stored-PC cells distinct until each update; provide the Remotion source and course kit with Remotion 4.0.410, React 19.0.0, TypeScript 5.8.2, Node.js, a Chromium render environment, and FFmpeg, with 1920x1080 H264 MP4 output and no audio; exact reproduction on a clean machine has not been verified.
